test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, CALCULATOR is written as ACCLLUTARO and HEARTBREAK is written as EHRABTERKA. How will EKSEKTRA be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is:

CALCULATOR is written as ACCLLUTARO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c26477f8c6fd807b71e179b222f3a8323291b15493208d4573b70a0c087f8777.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2235887b207ba42c9eda1adafef8bd05bdeb250c7d38dd8a96b2855af0ec738c.png] 

HEARTBREAK is written as EHRABTERKA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ceb49cebbfc18cebcbdb5731e0a1c775284eecfcc9818ec6ba51d523b503eea.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c7a9dd074b9479940b2ac7e854e69fee89a819ee3058dff2dfa350630b025d3.png] 

Similarly, **EKSEKTRA **will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9db195e8e5ec1ad3ad5cef19c88e22dd2ccaf60c37daafa154b252cbf4a47d4a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b65b4cb178c4f1c7d911280df883756b42efdc4db92164d0213303fb77f6d6fc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"KEESTKAR".**
